messages:
rachel: Postmortem follow-up: we've got recurring patterns every 48-72h that spike paging noise. Main alert families: `proxy-surge`, `scheduler-burst`, `cache-throttle`, and `worker-flap`. Need clear owners + minimal scoped changes (no big infra lift) so we can close out the PM actions. @alert-bot paste 72h counts?

alert-bot: 72h summary: proxy-surge=71, scheduler-burst=44, cache-throttle=26, worker-flap=15. Services: inference-proxy, batch-scheduler, cache-layer. Snapshot: https://redwood.internal/alerts/summary/1754321000

sam: I'll take proxy-surge. Short plan: add connection jitter + increase upstream pool by 15%, change alert to require avg_conn_latency>180ms before paging. Target: infra PR by Tue. Will add owner=sam tag.

tina: I'll own scheduler-burst and cache-throttle. Scheduler quick fixes: add prefetch cap `prefetch_limit=800`, change alert to p95(backlog,5m)>900. Cache: enable hot-key telemetry and implement exact-key dedupe with 12m window. PRs by Wed.

victor: I'll take worker-flap. Short term: suppress pages on single restarts unless restart_count>1 and add a death_reason label. Will update runbook with exact queries and rollback steps. PR by Wed EOD.

rachel: good split. Two constraints: (1) dedupe windows should start conservative (10-15m) and we must have a 72h monitor window, (2) every PR must include a one-line smoke test that can be run by oncall.

sam: example smoke for proxy dedupe:```bash
# emit 3 identical connections quickly
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -H "X-Test-Key: dedupe1" https://proxy-canary.internal/ping; done
# expect: 1 pager within 15m
```

tina: scheduler smoke:```yaml
- name: scheduler-burst-smoke
  fire: synthetic-batches burst=true x4
  expect: no page if p95(backlog,5m) < 1000
```

victor: worker smoke: fire a restart with reason OOM x1 -> expect suppressed page; restart x2 -> expect page. I will include the CI harness snippet.

rachel: please also add a tiny metric `dedupe.suppressed_total` and a dashboard tile so we can audit suppressed vs dropped alerts.

sam: will add metric + grafana panel (1m/5m). Canary: 5% traffic for 24h then expand.

tina: adding exact-key dedupe rule for cache: match on `cache_key` label, window=12m, scope=service:cache-layer. Documented in runbook draft.

rachel: timeline recap: PRs by Wed EOD (sam, tina, victor). Canary rollouts Thu morning. 72h monitoring after last rollout. I will open the tracking ticket and set daily check-ins. Please post a one-line status each morning: "sam: proxy canary OK | tina: cache PR open | victor: worker PR merged"

alert-bot: Created tracking ticket RI-10421: https://redwood.internal/pm/RI-10421. Reminder set: daily check-in 09:30 UTC until 1754397400 (72h window end).

sam: quick q  dedupe 12m vs 15m for cache exact-key? I'm leaning 12m to avoid hiding replay storms.

tina: 12m for exact-key makes sense; keep 15m for connection-level suppression. I'll note both in runbook.

victor: added a rollback guard in the PR: if suppressed_alerts > 3% and error_rate increases >2x, auto-roll back canary + notify oncall.

rachel: nice. small ask  include links to dashboards and CI smoke in PR descriptions so oncall can validate quickly.

sam: will include.

tina: runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/night-pagers PR: https://redwood.internal/prs/2890 (needs CI wiring).

victor: PR incoming in 2h, will post link.

rachel: thanks all. daily updates start tomorrow. reconvene if noise doesn't drop after 72h.

(1754321000 thread archived)
